lines.text: Welfare facilities are provided for your use, and must be kept clean and tidy.
Use the designated toilets, washing facilities, and rest areas.
Wash your hands before eating, drinking, or smoking, particularly after handling chemicals, concrete, contaminated materials, or working in drainage environments.
Smoking and vaping are only permitted in designated areas.
Keep access routes, emergency equipment, and working areas clear.
Everyone is responsible for maintaining good housekeeping throughout the working day.
Keep it clean. Wash your hands. Keep it clear.
